tools.name: cortex
tools.description: Lazy-load router to the real cortex MCP server. Forward { operation, args? } and the facade will lazily spawn the real server on first use.

operation.description: Real cortex operation name (for example search_corpus or take_screenshot).

args.description: Arguments object for the real operation; omit when the operation takes no arguments.

tools.name: get_slice_context
tools.description: Return a deterministic, COMPACT context window for a slice_id from the active plan step and Cortex search_context. The response contains the essential slice boundary fields needed for routing decisions (~700 bytes, 11 fields). To retrieve the full plan document, use cortex:load_document instead. For specific file context, prefer load_chunk or load_document.

slice_id.description: Unique slice identifier (exact slice_id) or the symbolic step label (e.g. B1) for the active step.

plan_path.description: Optional repo-relative plan path within plans/ to load for this call only.
